panels.description: Adrian’s hologram appears above the workbench and looks toward Alex, who is a silhouette in the foreground with thumb over the watch. Keep the upper-left clear.
Alex’s set jaw and bright eyes in blue hologram light. No lettering.
Adrian’s hologram at left, Alex at center and Grandmother in the bookshelf doorway. Leave upper-left and upper-right clear.

Adrian turns serious as the hologram shifts burgundy; Grandmother’s hand presses to her chest. Reserve separate upper-left and lower-left zones for two short apology balloons, keeping Adrian’s face and Grandmother’s reaction visible.
Adrian leans toward the lens as scan lines begin. Reserve upper-left for the first short instruction and lower-right for the second; keep his face visible.
The hologram is gone. Alex sits in blue-grey afterglow with Bi11bot’s amber eyes at frame edge and unfolds Adrian’s photograph. No lettering.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: Hello, Alex. If you're seeing this... then you found the workshop.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: Which means your grandmother still refuses to throw anything away.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: I wasn't there when you needed me. I'm sorry.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: I made one bad call. I was wrong.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: You don't have to finish what I started. Find a better way.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: Bi11bot has a map. Question everything. Especially me.
